openapi_validity.notes: swagger-cli validate OK; openapi 3.1.0; 78 operations; 92+ schemas; no $ref breakage; no type:any.

us_endpoints_coverage.notes: 100% US mapped to endpoints (or to UI-only when applicable: US-001..006, 022, 023, 102, 200, 202, 203, 205, 206). 4 roles explicit via RegisterRolePath enum [influencer, business, agency, brand].

ac_error_codes_coverage.notes: All HTTP error codes wired via shared responses. Critical business codes (PROFILE_INCOMPLETE/SLOT_FULL/EXPIRED/ALREADY_APPLIED) inline on /marketplace/apply. Secondary business codes (EMAIL_TAKEN, LINK_EXPIRED, WIZARD_INCOMPLETE, etc.) listed in api-contract.md §4 transversal table but not duplicated inline per endpoint.

schemas_complete.notes: All schemas typed; required fields explicit; enums for Role/Platform/Tier/CampaignStatus/PaymentStatus/CinStatus/IssueType/BillingProfile/Currency. Moroccan patterns present (ICE ^\d{15}$, RIB ^\d{24}$, phone ^\+212\d{9}$, MAD enum). Description/example missing on ~30% of sub-DTO fields.

error_codes_documented.notes: Standard HTTP codes per verb consistent (POST 201/400/401/403/409/422/500, GET 200/401/403/404/500, PATCH 200/400/401/403/404/422/500, DELETE 204/401/403/404/500). Some POST mutations omit 422 (covered by 400 + 409).

auth_consistent.notes: bearerAuth (http/bearer/JWT) defined. Global security: [bearerAuth]. Public endpoints opt-out via security: []. Aligned with ADR-005 (RS256, 15min access, 7d refresh rotation, magic link single-use).

us_modules_mapping.notes: Explicit US → backend module + frontend feature mapping in application-architecture.md §4. 13/13 SA bounded contexts mapped 1:1 to NestJS modules.

improvements_recommended.action: Inline secondary business error codes per endpoint (EMAIL_TAKEN, INVALID_CREDENTIALS, LINK_EXPIRED, LINK_INVALID, WIZARD_INCOMPLETE, ALREADY_PUBLISHED, CIN_ALREADY_VALIDATED, BRAND_ALREADY_LINKED, CIN_NOT_PENDING, PAYMENT_NOT_FAILED, INVALID_DISC_FILTER, AI_RATE_LIMITED, BRIEF_NOT_READY) currently only in api-contract.md §4 table.
Add description + example on remaining sub-DTO fields (CreatorProfileTab*, WizardStep*Request).
Add 422 response on /business/marketplace/products and /business/crm/lists POST mutations to homogenize with api-contract.md §2.5 conventions.
